name: rank-and-yank
description: Run your most expensive model as an orchestrator. Cheaper agents compete for a capped roster.

plugins.name: rank-and-yank
plugins.description: Standing operating mode that spends your expensive model's tokens on judgment and pushes execution down to cheaper subagents, which compete for a capped per-project roster with real scores, real elimination, and a channel to push back on bad instructions.
